topics.name: Ukraine Operation Spider Web Drone Attack
topics.summary: Ukraine deployed FPV drones hidden in shipping containers disguised as garden sheds, trucked near five Russian air bases 400km inside Russia. Drones operated on cellular networks to evade GPS and traditional RF jamming, destroyed irreplaceable Russian strategic bombers. Described as a landmark in asymmetric drone warfare.

topics.name: Counter-UAS Technology and Defense
topics.summary: Discussed the multi-layered approach needed to defend against drone swarms: EW jamming, laser systems, kinetic interceptors, machine gun turrets, and cellular network shutdown. US described as significantly behind in practical FPV drone electronic warfare countermeasures; critical infrastructure vulnerability highlighted.

topics.name: Mary Meeker AI Trends Report
topics.summary: Bond Capital released a 300+ slide AI trends report highlighting ChatGPT at 800M weekly users, Big Six tech CapEx exceeding $212B, AI inference costs falling faster than any prior technology curve, non-North American LLM users at 90% of internet users, and Waymo dominating ride-share in San Francisco.

topics.name: AI Application Layer Investment
topics.summary: Abridge for doctors raised over $400M and doubled valuation to $5.3B; Harvey for lawyers drawing major attention. Vertical AI applications are a leading investment narrative with OpenAI at near-saturation consumer penetration suggesting room for specialized verticals.

topics.name: Defense Tech Manufacturing and Supply Chain
topics.summary: US drone production significantly lags Ukraine's estimated 4.5M FPV drones per year. Brushless motors identified as critical supply chain bottleneck dominated by China along with neodymium magnets. Neiros cited as highest-rate US producer at 1,500/month, far behind wartime needs.

topics.name: Rottman VC Performance List
topics.summary: Cole Rottman created a methodology tracking Series A lead investors by board membership in $5B+ outcome companies since 2012. Top tier with three outcomes: Doug Leone, Hamant, Keith Raboy, Mark Andreessen. Viewed as cleaner than Midas List due to attribution gaming issues at funds.

topics.name: Fake ARR and Circular Revenue Scandals
topics.summary: Builder AI shut down after faking business with Versi Innovation to falsely inflate ARR; neither company actually provided products or services. Connected to broader dot-com era circular revenue recognition concerns and hyperscaler compute-for-investment dynamics.

topics.name: Golden Dome Missile Defense
topics.summary: Trump administration's national missile defense initiative discussed as a Manhattan Project-scale undertaking requiring new budget lines, congressional support, space-based components, and new low-cost missile effectors. Implementation details unknown; viewed as principally sound but with major execution uncertainty.

topics.name: Immigration and STEM Talent Pipeline
topics.summary: Jordan Schneider raised concerns about threats to Harvard's international enrollment, potential OPT revocation, and NSF funding cuts. US CS graduate programs cited as over 70% foreign students; policies risk losing critical research talent and could cause university funding crises.

topics.name: Autonomous Vehicles and Waymo Expansion
topics.summary: Waymo showing strong market dominance over Lyft in San Francisco per Mary Meeker data and rapidly expanding in LA. Human-to-vehicle support ratio approximately 1.4-1.7. Ongoing debate about whether teleoperation undermines the autonomous narrative or is a feature for safety.

topics.name: Mountainhead Film Review
topics.summary: Jesse Armstrong's film features four tech entrepreneurs at a Park City poker weekend during a deepfake AI-caused global crisis; reviewed as a critique of tech billionaires using insider terminology like P-doom and D-cell but landing awkwardly for both tech insiders and general audiences. 79% on Rotten Tomatoes.

topics.name: AI Inference Cost Decline
topics.summary: Mary Meeker report showed AI inference costs falling dramatically faster than historical cost curves for electric power or computer memory, enabling broader application development and improving economics for vertical AI companies.

topics.name: DJI Ban Considerations
topics.summary: Post-Ukraine drone attack, DJI's dominant position in civilian and military drone markets faces potential US ban. Concerns include dual-use manufacturing capacity, Chinese supply chain dependency, and potential backdoor cellular or satellite access. No executive order yet but seen as likely.

topics.name: Fiber Optic Drone Control
topics.summary: Ukraine's front-line drones increasingly use fiber optic cable spools instead of radio signals, making them immune to electronic warfare jamming. Visible as miles of tangled filament cable along Ukrainian front lines; limits range but provides reliable jam-proof control.

topics.name: Higher Education Reform
topics.summary: Discussion of higher ed as a bundle including signaling, community, and research mentorship; federal student loan inflation blamed for non-elite university cost bloat. Suggestion that elite universities be required to spend endowments and grow class sizes rather than stay artificially small.

topics.name: VO3 and Generative Video
topics.summary: Google VO3 generating millions of videos in days since launch, now on mobile in more countries. Discussed in context of Mountainhead's plot about deepfakes causing global chaos; debate about whether generative video truly changes the misinformation landscape versus existing tools already enabling it.
